decisions.reason: The source refines the Hero V's arms and vertex but does not change the existing requirement that the closing V derive from the Hero V's shared geometry.
The source concerns only Hero V geometry and does not alter the deferred construction, character, or supporting role of the E and L letterforms.
The Hero V refinement does not change the established rule that the É accent derives from and corresponds to the Hero V geometry.
Arm weight, asymmetry, and vertex refinement do not change the deferred wordmark kerning and cohesive-reading requirement.
The source changes structural geometry only and neither resumes nor modifies the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
The Hero V design refinement is unrelated to the accepted formats for accessible review-image delivery.
